summary: MasterCraft Boat Holdings filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval at a special meeting for a stock-and-cash merger with Marine Products Corporation. The merger involves two steps: Merger Sub 1 merging into Marine Products, then Marine Products merging into Merger Sub 2, making Marine Products a wholly owned subsidiary. Proposal 1 (share issuance) passed overwhelmingly (13,740,660 for, 6,290 against). The HSR waiting period expired on April 6, 2026, satisfying a condition. Closing is expected on or about May 15, 2026. The event is a routine voting update and not a new special situation.
